title: SSH Gateway
subtitle: Platform owners see the gateway state, every server credential and the global audit here. Changes are made on the Servers tab of the owning workspace.

status.title: Gateway state
status.configHint: Change the switch, owner allowlist and user allowlist in system settings (SSH_GATEWAY_ENABLED, SSH_GATEWAY_OWNER_ACCOUNTS, SSH_GATEWAY_USER_ACCOUNTS)

credentials.title: All credentials
credentials.subtitle: Read-only. Add, edit or delete from the Servers tab of the owning workspace.
credentials.emptyHint: Create one on a workspace Servers tab, or import from workspace resources.
credentials.ownerNotWhitelisted: The credential owner is not on the allowlist, so this cannot be used yet

statusReasons.auth_failed: Authentication failed last time; update the credential before enabling it again

secret.undecryptable: The secret cannot be decrypted. Restore the original key or enter it again.

import.confirmContent: Import the three SSH templates from workspace resources as platform servers, following the current bindings. Existing resources are left untouched and already imported entries are not duplicated.
import.noneImported: No new credentials were imported this time
import.securityHint: These credentials used to enter the container. Consider replacing them after the migration.

audit.title: Global audit
audit.subtitle: All workspaces, newest first; reason codes are translated.

reasons.isolation_off: Network isolation is not active in this workspace, so server connections are unavailable
reasons.image_too_old: The CC sandbox image is too old; ask the platform owner to upgrade
reasons.no_lease: The current task has no authorization to use servers
reasons.not_covered: This task's authorization does not cover this server
reasons.owner_changed: The authorization basis changed (allowlist, user allowlist or instance state)
reasons.workspace_not_platform: This workspace is no longer owned by the platform, so platform servers are suspended
reasons.undecryptable: The credential cannot be decrypted; ask the platform owner or the credential owner to fix it
reasons.target_blocked: This server resolves to an address that is not allowed
reasons.host_key_mismatch: The server host key does not match the recorded one; the connection was refused, please verify
reasons.upstream_auth_failed: Login with the recorded credential failed; this credential has been paused
reasons.mfa_required: The server requires two-factor authentication, which the gateway does not support
reasons.channel_unsupported: Agent forwarding and X11 forwarding are not supported
